title: Vrykul Armament: native timed reagent cast confirmed, retail forge and acquisition still unproven
scope: Code/data research only. User requested comparison against DBC/DB2, Wowhead and other GitHub sources, prioritizing original behavior over an authored restoration. No WoW client operation.
status: Research complete for the sources listed below. The speculative restoration was withdrawn. No new gameplay implementation or World migration is delivered; original availability, acquisition and forge placement remain unresolved.
previous_evidence_preserved: The previous audit's brew repair, weighted objectives and client limitations remain unchanged. This follow-up expands its unresolved armament note; it does not declare the armament route retail-verified, unused or removed.

confirmed_native_data.native_dispatch_inspection: Spell::EffectTriggerSpell in SpellEffects.cpp switches to TRIGGERED_NONE when the child CalcCastTime is nonzero, and effect160 forwards the child's cast time. Preserve the native cast/cost path if a future restoration is justified. Effect134 uses group event credit; personal-only credit is an authored change, not an established original requirement.

external_sources.finding: Retrieved Stormheim script has no armament/forge implementation. Scoped GitHub code searches did not recover the route; absence from indexed results is not proof about every branch/file.

Pinned legion-branch Stormheim loader is empty. Modern master Stormheim script and indexed historical quest SQL provide no retrieved implementation of this route. This source cannot fill the missing retail spawn/drop evidence.

Original forge entry, model, location and interaction binding

decision.not_a_conclusion: Missing bindings plus an inconsistent item spell can suggest an unfinished or obsolete design, but these sources do not prove it was removed from retail. Keep availability unresolved rather than labelling the whole route repaired or deprecated.
